items.jobDescription:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. 
 The Opportunity
 Are you a self-driven engineer who thrives on the shop floor? We are looking for a pragmatic, structured, and hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Production and Maintenance Team in the heart of Zurich.
 In this role, you work in the value stream, taking responsibility for our daily manufacturing operations. You provide first-level support and diagnose technical issues to maintain throughput and testing uptime. Your scope includes the maintenance of our current robot generation and driving the NPI execution on the shop floor, specifically the build and troubleshooting of prototypes and zero-series units.
 You act as the interface between Industrialisation, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, and Logistics, while collaborating with our EMS partner to ensure stable series production. If you have an "on-hands" mentality and want to implement KPIs to resolve bottlenecks in a high-tech scale-up, this is your next challenge.
 The Market & Our Technology
 ANYbotics transforms the industrial sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach (see our case studies in Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Railways, Wind Energy, Mining, Construction). Our customers are large asset operators and service providers of industrial plants pioneering robotics technology f or inspection and maintenance. Our solution enables autonomous routine inspections and monitoring of large-scale industrial facilities for increased safety and productivity . We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and software to achieve world-class mobility, autonomy, and inspection capabilities, often based on AI. We have proven the t echnology and the business impact on our customers in long-term pilot projects. We are now scaling the commercialization of our solution(s) and deploying directly into operation at customer facilities worldwide.
 Your Impact 
 Provide first-level technical support to ensure efficient production flow and minimize downtime
 Document Non-Conformities (NCRs), perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions
 Take ownership of the maintenance, calibration, and improvement of production tooling and test equipment
 Monitor First Pass Yield (FPY) and throughput times consistently to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks
 Lead projects and initiatives to optimize output, efficiency, and on-time delivery
 Drive the optimization of the end-to-end value stream for pilot series production and maintenance operations
 Execute New Product Introduction (NPI) and the implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on the shop floor
 Ensure test procedures and work instructions are technically accurate and up to date
 Your Profile 
 Bachelor’s degree or technical diploma (HF/FH) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics
 3 years+ experience in a high-tech manufacturing or robotics environment
 Strong troubleshooting ability with a self-driven proactive and structured mindset
 Experience with test instruments, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and power supplies
 Proven hands-on skills in soldering, crimping, and cable assembly
 Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
 Excellent technical communication and presentation skills
 Fluency in German and English (Level B2 minimum)
 Bonus Points 
 Knowledge of lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies
 Experience with test data analysis or yield monitoring tools
 Familiarity with firmware update and validation workflows
 Driving license CH-Cat. B
 We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich. 
 Agency Policy:  We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring. items.jobDescription:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
 The Team 
 Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the Celonis Services organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:
 Make Celonis Business Critical: Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.
 Scale Customer Health: Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.
 Focus on High-Value Activities: Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.
 Empower Career Growth: Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.
 We deliver production-ready Celonis Platform implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a Discover-and-Build approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.
 In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy operational, AI-enriched solutions on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.
 We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by state-of-the-art AI augmentation , allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the "eyes and ears" in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.
 The Role 
 As an Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program , you will support the end-to-end "Discover-and-Build" journey for our global customers. items.jobTitle: Computer Vision and Machine Learning Engineer
items.jobDescription:
We are looking for a Computer Vision and Machine Learning (CV/ML) Engineer to develop and deploy intelligent perception systems for our autonomous drone-in-a-box platform. You will work on challenging real-world computer vision problems, from real-time object detection and tracking on embedded devices to advanced scene understanding and cloud-based inference. As part of a small, technical team, you will own solutions across our software stack, taking algorithms and models from prototype to deployment. This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office.
 Responsibilities
 Design and develop a wide variety of computer vision and machine learning features for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications
 Train, fine-tune and evaluate deep learning models for tasks such as object detection, instance segmentation, image retrieval/reidentification
 Optimize algorithms and models for edge devices (NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm Dragonwing), and integrate them into our image and video processing pipelines
 Monitor ML model performance in real-world deployments and set up workflows for continuous improvement (data collection, curation, labeling, retraining, evaluation)
 Evaluate and integrate large/vision language models for scene understanding, situational awareness, and hazard analysis, including prompt design, performance benchmarking, and production deployment
 Qualifications
 Degree in Computer Science, Robotics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 Solid understanding of computer vision and machine learning fundamentals
 Strong programming skills in Python and C++, with experience developing production-grade software that powers CV/ML systems
 Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA
 Experience with end-to-end model development: from dataset curation, labeling strategies, active learning workflows to deployment and optimization for edge devices
 Excellent oral and written skills in English
 Work permit in Switzerland required
 Bonus Points
 Good understanding of 3D vision and robotics perception, along with hands-on experience with OpenCV and ROS/ROS2, is a strong plus
 Experience with NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm edge devices, and their CV/ML SDKs
 Experience with transformers, large/vision language models and prompt design for perception tasks
 Experience with complex GStreamer pipelines and custom plugin development
 100% · On-site

items.jobDescription:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Why Deliveroo?
 We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.
 Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact on your own development, on Deliveroo as we scale, and on the marketplace and communities we serve.
 Consumer Ordering Experience owns the core purchase journey: the store page, item page, basket, and checkout flow, across both app and web. It's a global team — the surfaces we build support all of our brands: Deliveroo, Wolt, and Doordash. You'd be the team's first dedicated web/full-stack engineer, helping us build out our web experience from the ground up.
 What You'll Do
 Own and evolve the store, item, basket, and checkout experiences on web, working primarily in React and TypeScript
 Contribute to backend services written in Golang — deep Go experience isn't a hard requirement, but you should be comfortable picking up a new statically typed backend language
 Improve code structure, shape architecture, and review code across the team
 Partner closely with your Product Manager and fellow engineers to scope and ship changes to the ordering funnel
 Take part in the hiring process and support the growth of your teammates as the team scales
 What We're Looking For
 Must haves: 
 Strong full-stack experience — comfortable working across web frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go, or similar) to unblock delivery end-to-end
 Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results
 Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)
 Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief PRD through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding
 Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches
 Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents
 Nice to haves: 
 Experience coordinating engineers across multiple platforms (iOS/Android/Web/BE) on a single initiative
 Active use of AI-assisted coding workflows, and interest in building reusable tooling/skills for the team
 We're looking for someone London-based who can work from our office 2–3 days a week alongside the rest of the team.
 Why Join Us? 
 At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.
 ➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog .
 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.
 Our Global Structure 
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
 If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are manufactured using ZEISS technologies.  Defining technical specifications and framework conditions for internal and external development partners, creating work packages, and overseeing their implementation

items.jobTitle: Students: Parametric CAD & Mesh Automation for Power-Electronic Modules
items.jobDescription:
The Fraunhofer Institute for Electronic Nanosystems ENAS specializes in the development of smart systems – so-called intelligent systems for a wide range of applications. These systems combine electronic components, micro- and nanosensors, and actuators with communication interfaces. Fraunhofer ENAS develops individual components, the technologies for their manufacture, as well as system concepts and system integration technologies, and translates them into practical applications. Fraunhofer ENAS supports customer projects from the initial idea through design, technology development, or implementation using existing technologies, all the way to a tested prototype.
 The Micro Materials Centre (MMC) department is concerned with the reliability of electronic components. The application-oriented research aims to improve the reliability of electronic components by means of suitable experimental investigations and the use of numerical models and, furthermore, to carry out a prognosis of the remaining service life.
This position focuses on developing an open-source workflow for parametric geometry generation and automated meshing of power-electronic modules. The extended research investigates AI based approaches to automating CAD modeling and mesh generation.

About WPP Media 
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 
 WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
 For more information, visit wppmedia.com .
 About DTA
 DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We bring together technology, data and analytics to help agencies and clients transform the value of data.
 Our platform, Open Media Studio, is an AI-enabled media and data platform built for the next era of advertising. Our 1,000-plus team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem-solvers works across 20 markets worldwide.
 The opportunity
 We’re looking for a hands-on Security Engineer to help design, build and operate secure cloud platforms, data pipelines and data-sharing solutions. These capabilities support our internal product teams and deliver data to clients—either in client-owned cloud environments or in our own.
 The role is GCP-first, with security patterns that can be applied across AWS and Azure. You’ll help embed security into infrastructure, identities, data products and AI-enabled services from the start—not bolt it on later.
 As AI agents connect to data and systems through technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), our security model needs to account for machine identities, tool permissions and automated actions. You’ll help build the controls that make these services safe to use, including authentication, authorisation, monitoring and protection against risks such as prompt injection, tool misuse and data leakage.
 You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Security Operations, Privacy, Legal, Marketing and Client Delivery teams. The goal is to make the secure approach the easiest approach—and to deliver reliable, well-governed data to our clients.
 What you’ll do
 Secure cloud platforms and automation
 Build and improve secure cloud foundations in GCP, including resource hierarchies, organisation policies, VPC Service Controls, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) and centralised logging.
 Develop reusable Terraform modules and project factories so teams can provision, test and redeploy secure environments consistently.
 Apply policy-as-code in CI/CD, use keyless pipelines through workload identity federation, and automate detection and remediation of configuration drift.
 Help establish equivalent security patterns in AWS and Azure.
 Protect AI agents and MCP services
 Help design and evolve secure patterns for MCP hosts, clients, servers, gateways and registries.
 Build or operate MCP gateways and registries with approved-tool allowlisting, tool-level authorisation, rate limits and auditable records of tool calls.
 Implement OAuth 2.1/OIDC authorisation using short-lived, scoped and audience-bound tokens; avoid token passthrough and require human approval for high-impact actions.
 Help secure MCP services hosted on Cloud Run or GKE, using controls such as Identity-Aware Proxy and prompt or response screening.
 Threat-model and help defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, unauthorised tool changes, confused-deputy attacks and data exfiltration through chained tool calls.
 Help secure the agent and connector supply chain through vetting, signing, versioning, scanning and sandboxing.
 Engineer identity and access controls
 Implement identity patterns for people, workloads and agents across Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including federation, SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access and phishing-resistant MFA.
 Extend identity governance to service accounts, API keys, workload identities and AI agents, using Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform.
 Support clear ownership, lifecycle management and regular access reviews for non-human identities.
 Apply zero-standing-privilege principles through just-in-time elevation, short-lived credentials and automated access revocation.
 Assess emerging capabilities such as Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Okta Cross App Access.
 Protect data and enable secure sharing
 Build data transformation pipelines and governed data products using dbt, SQL and Terraform.
 Apply controls such as data classification, lineage, model contracts, policy tags, masking, row-level security and least-privilege access.
 Help deliver data securely to clients and partners through BigQuery Analytics Hub, cross-cloud storage transfers and API integrations.
 Support secure ingestion, cleansing, enrichment and transformation, with scoped access, encryption, audit logging and monitoring at each hand-off.
 Develop secure data-sharing patterns, including data clean rooms and consent-aware pipelines.
 Help prevent sensitive data from leaking into agent prompts, context windows, logs or third-party models, and ensure agents access curated data rather than unrestricted raw tables.
 Secure social and marketing platforms
 Bring brand social accounts, advertising platforms and martech tools under central identity control using Cerby or a comparable solution.
 Support secure onboarding and offboarding, credential rotation, enforced MFA and time-limited, auditable access for agencies, freelancers and creators.
 Treat social content—including comments, direct messages, reviews and mentions—as untrusted input.
 Design guardrails so agents cannot combine access to private data, untrusted content and the ability to publish externally without appropriate safeguards.
 Work with Marketing and Communications teams to detect and respond to account takeovers, impersonation and advertising-account fraud.
 Improve detection, response and secure delivery
 Send cloud, identity, MCP, model-safety and social-platform logs to the SIEM.
 Build detections as code and develop SOAR playbooks that can revoke tokens, disable agents, quarantine MCP servers and rotate credentials, with human approval for high-impact actions.
 Create golden paths, reference implementations and runbooks that help delivery teams build securely and independently.
 Contribute to threat-modelling sessions, red-team exercises, design reviews and audit-readiness activities.
 Help map controls to relevant standards and automate evidence collection.
 Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers.
 What you’ll bring
 Experience and technical skills
 Seasoned experience in cloud infrastructure, platform, data or security engineering, including hands-on GCP experience in production .
 Strong practical GCP skills, such as IAM, organisation policies, networking, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Run or GKE, and BigQuery.
 Working knowledge of comparable security capabilities in AWS and Azure.
 Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, environment and state management, testing, CI/CD and policy-as-code.
 Experience engineering identity controls with Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta, including SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access, MFA and privileged or just-in-time access. Familiarity with Saviynt or another IGA platform is expected.
 Hands-on SIEM and SOAR experience, including onboarding log sources, developing detections and building response playbooks.
 Practical understanding of MCP and agent security. This could come from production work, open-source contributions or well-developed proofs of concept.
 Experience with dbt and SQL for data transformation or data products, and a working understanding of data-layer controls such as classification, masking, row-level security and access grants.
 Experience delivering data to clients or partners across organisational or cloud boundaries, using services such as BigQuery Analytics Hub, GCS, S3, Azure Blob Storage or APIs.
 Coding ability in Python, Go or TypeScript for automation, tooling or MCP server development.
 Familiarity with social, advertising or marketing platforms and the security challenges involved in managing brand accounts and non-SSO applications.
 How you work
 You build securely by default and consider how systems could be misused from the outset.
 You automate repeatable work, test what you codify and look for ways to make secure delivery easier.
 You balance risk, usability and delivery needs, and can explain when a solution is not ready—and what would make it safe to proceed.
 You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and can explain security risks in plain language.
 You document decisions and create practical standards, golden paths and runbooks.
 You measure outcomes, learn from incidents and feedback, and improve controls over time.
 You collaborate inclusively, seek different perspectives and support the development of colleagues.
 Security and regulatory frameworks
 You’ll be familiar with relevant security, privacy and AI frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, CIS Benchmarks, UK GDPR/GDPR and the EU AI Act.
 Certifications
 You should hold—or be willing to achieve after joining:
 Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect within six months.
 Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer within 12 months.
 WPP will fund exam fees and provide dedicated study time.
 Nice to have
 Experience operating MCP servers or gateways in production, or contributing to open-source agent or security tooling.
 Google Security Operations or Microsoft Sentinel experience, particularly detection-as-code practices.
 Kubernetes or service-mesh security experience, including workload identity, policy controllers or mTLS.
 Software supply-chain security experience, such as SLSA, Sigstore/cosign, SBOMs or Binary Authorization.
 Privacy engineering or AI assurance experience, including data clean rooms, consent management, pseudonymisation or AI red-teaming.
 Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS, OWASP GenAI guidance or AI security testing.
 Agency, media or consumer-brand experience, particularly in environments requiring multi-client data segregation.
 Further relevant certifications, such as Google Professional Security Operations Engineer, Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Microsoft SC-300/AZ-500, Okta Certified Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or CCSP.
 Life at WPP Media
 Our work is powered by a commitment to Be Extraordinary : investing in our people and supporting transformational creativity. We Lead Optimistically , champion growth and development, and create opportunities for colleagues to build connections and learn across WPP Media and WPP’s global network.
 We aim to create an open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and can progress. Optical SSA / Image Processing Engineer 
 This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. 
 About us 
 Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.
 We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.
 Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.
 We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

 London · Full time · On-site
 As well as ranging with lasers, our stations track satellites optically. You'll build the image processing that finds, tracks and measures objects in our camera data.

 What you'll bring 
 A degree in physics, astronomy, computer science or similar
 Image processing and computer vision in Python or C++
 Astrometry and photometry experience, for example with astropy or Source Extractor
 Knowledge of camera sensors: noise, calibration and time-stamping
 Nice to have 
 Space situational awareness or satellite tracking
 GPU processing
 Machine learning for detection
 Amateur astronomy

 Cycle to work schemes
 Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

As an **Equipment & Test Engineer**, you will take technical ownership of equipment used for the qualification and reliability testing of power semiconductor devices, particularly SiC MOSFETs. Working closely with Product Qualification Engineering, R&D and suppliers you will maintain and improve existing equipment while developing new test and automation solutions. This multidisciplinary and hands-on role combines equipment engineering, measurement technology, electronics development, software, and test automation.
# What you will do
- Manage laboratory and reliability test equipment throughout its lifecycle, including acquisition, commissioning, operation, maintenance, calibration, upgrades, and decommissioning
- Ensure equipment availability and performance through systematic troubleshooting, supplier coordination, and monitoring of relevant KPIs such as downtime, calibration status, issue resolution, and measurement stability
- Prepare, execute, and improve electrical and thermal reliability tests in coordination with Product Qualification Engineers, including the analysis of test conditions, equipment limitations, and measurement results
- Develop and improve electronic circuits, control boards, interfaces, fixtures, embedded systems, and automated test solutions
- Troubleshoot complete systems across hardware, firmware, communication interfaces, host software, and graphical user interfaces
- Lead technical work packages from requirements and supplier selection through installation, verification, validation, and release
- Apply laboratory best practices regarding safety, usability, standardization, traceability, documentation, and continuous improvement
- Create and maintain manuals, working instructions, risk assessments, test procedures, and technical reports
- Maintain and improve laboratory asset management, including equipment tracking, barcode verification, and dashboard reporting
- Support user training, FMEA, and the standardization of test processes
# What you will need
- A degree in electronical engineering or a comparable technical discipline
- Relevant experience in test engineering, electronics development, automation, or a similar technical environment
- A strong **hands-on mentality** and the motivation to build, wire, commission, measure, troubleshoot, and improve technical systems
- Good knowledge of electronic circuits, measurement technology, laboratory equipment, and systematic fault analysis
- Practical experience with oscilloscopes, data-acquisition systems, programmable power supplies, function generators, or similar laboratory instruments
- The ability to understand complete systems across hardware, firmware, communication, and software
- Experience in reading, creating, or modifying electronic schematics
- Basic programming knowledge and the willingness to work with existing firmware, software, and automated test applications
- A structured and analytical working style with a strong quality, safety, and documentation mindset
- Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to independently drive technical work packages
- German/English spoken and written
# What would be an advantage
- Knowledge of discrete power semiconductors, particularly SiC MOSFETs
- Experience with qualification or reliability tests such as HTRB, H3TRB, PCT, DGS, IOL, TDDB, or thermal-resistance measurements
- Experience with KiCad, Altium Designer, or comparable electronic design tools
- Programming knowledge in Python, C/C++, LabVIEW, Visual Basic, or MATLAB
- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, communication protocols, instrument control, or automated measurement systems
- Familiarity with AEC-Q101, AQG 324, relevant JEDEC standards, calibration, FMEA, risk assessment, verification, and validation

Lange-Electronic GmbH mit Sitz in Gernlinden im Westen von München ist Spezialist für PNT-Lösungen (Positionierung, Navigation, Timing). Wir bieten Zeit- und Frequenzsysteme mehrerer Hersteller, GNSS-Testlösungen und eigene Entwicklungen. In unserem Techniklabor entstehen Kleinstserien und Einzelanfertigungen für Kunden aus Industrie, Forschung und kritischer Infrastruktur, von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Gerät. Gerade starten wir zudem ein dreijähriges Forschungsprojekt zur resilienten Navigation. Für dieses Team suchen wir zum 1. Januar 2027 Verstärkung. 
 Aufgabenbereiche 
 Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Veriﬁkation elektronischer Baugruppen und Systeme, von der Platinenbestückung im eigenen Labor bis zur Betreuung externer Fertigungsaufträge
 Messtechnische Charakterisierung von Zeit- und Frequenzsystemen sowie Tests von GNSS-Empfängern mit professionellen GNSS-Simulatoren
 Firmwareentwicklung für Mikrocontroller in C/C++ und Mitarbeit an FPGA-basierten Systemen
 Systematische Fehleranalyse und Reparatur
 Technische Beratung unserer Kunden, auch vor Ort, bei der Integration präziser Zeit- und Navigationslösungen
 Mitarbeit in unserem Forschungsprojekt zur resilienten Navigation (u. a. Schutz vor GNSS-Jamming und -Spooﬁng), gemeinsam mit Partnern aus Industrie und Forschung
 Teilnahme an Fachkonferenzen, um aktuelle Entwicklungen zu verfolgen und unsere Arbeit zu präsentieren
 Mit wachsender Erfahrung: eigenverantwortliche Entwicklung neuer Baugruppen, vom Schaltungsentwurf bis zum Platinenlayout
 Qualifikationen 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik oder eines verwandten Fachs (Bachelor/Master) oder Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte/r Techniker/in der Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik
 Praktische Erfahrung im Laboralltag, etwa aus Praktika, Abschlussarbeit oder Beruf, idealerweise auch mit Bestückung und Löten von SMD-Bauteilen
 Kenntnisse in C/C++ und in der Programmierung von Mikrocontrollern
 Grundlagen im Schaltungs- und Platinendesign oder Interesse, sich darin weiterzuentwickeln
 Selbstständige, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Lösung technischer Probleme für kritische Anwendungen
 Kommunikationsstärke im Kundenkontakt, gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in präziser Zeit- und Frequenzsynchronisation (z. B. PTP, NTP, Oszillatoren), in GNSS-Systemen oder in der GNSS-Simulation sind ein Plus, ebenso Erfahrung mit FPGAs, Python für Mess- und Testautomatisierung sowie Git.

Im DLR-Institut für KI-Sicherheit erforschen und entwickeln wir KI-bezogene Methoden, Prozesse, Algorithmen, Technologien und Ausführungs- bzw. Systemumgebungen. Unser Fokus liegt auf sicherer und norm- bzw. standardkonformer KI, Cybersicherheit in offenen Daten- und Dienste-Ökosystemen und KI, sowie der Automatisierung in Mobilität und Logistik.
 Die Abteilung KI Engineering definiert und etabliert systematische und zielorientierte Entwicklungsprozesse, Methoden und Werkzeuge für sichere KI-basierte Anwendungen. Im Fokus stehen dabei die Entwicklung und Anwendung von Safety- & Security-by-Design-Methoden für KI-basierte Komponenten sowie die Untersuchung sicherer Mensch-KI-Interaktion unter Berücksichtigung von Automatisierungs- und Kooperationsgrad.
 Deine Aufgaben  
•    Entwicklung von Virtual-Reality- und Hybrid-Reality-Simulationsumgebungen (z. B. mit Unreal Engine)
•    Implementierung von KI-Systemen für Safety & Security-by-Design Engineering-Prozesse
•    Gezielte Erzeugung von Daten und Testumgebungen, welche durch den Menschen in Kombination mit dem KI-System erzeugt werden und sich zum Trainieren und Testen sicherer (safe & secure) KI-Systemen eignen
•    Entwicklung von sicheren (safe & secure) KI-Modellen in Simulationsumgebungen 
•    Entwicklung einer wissenschaftlich fundierten Systematik zur vergleichenden Bewertung aktueller Mensch-KI-Interaktionsansätze
•    Nachweis der Effektivität der Miteinbeziehung des Menschen in den KI-Lernzyklus
•    Konkrete Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung von Demonstratoren und den damit zusammenhängenden Prozessen
 Das bringst du mit  
•    Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium der Informatik, oder der Ingenieurwissenschaften (z.B. aus den Bereichen Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau) oder andere für die Tätigkeit relevanten Studiengänge
•    Programmierkenntnisse in Python
•    Kompetenzen in der Programmierung von Simulations- und Laborwerkzeugen (VR, HR)
•    Kompetenzen im Bereich von Künstlicher Intelligenz in autonomen Systemen
•    Programmierkenntnisse in Python und Kenntnisse im Bereich robotischer Systeme
•    Erfahrungen in verschiedenen Bereichen der Mensch-KI-Interaktion, optimalerweise in den Bereich Luftfahrt, Robotik oder autonomes Fahren
•    Kenntnisse in der Versuchsplanung, -durchführung und -auswertung

•    Sichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
•    Motivation zur Anleitung von Studierenden im Rahmen wissenschaftlicher Hilfstätigkeit oder Abschlussarbeit

If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs. 
🚀 Our Story
 Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.
 Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.
 Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly .
 🖍️ This role
 This is a forward-deployed solutions role at the front line of Partly's European expansion. You'll be the technical engine behind new-market deals across the UK and the Nordics, turning messy real-world problems into signed pilots and putting genuinely differentiated AI in front of the people who run the repair industry.
 Here's what you'd be working with. Partly runs two connected layers. Partly.com is the infrastructure platform, the B2B layer that powers parts data, cataloging, and procurement across hundreds of integrations globally. Partly.ai is the AI tool for repairers, built on top of that infrastructure, that makes finding and sourcing the right part feel like magic. Both are powered by Interpreter, Partly's proprietary foundation model for understanding automotive parts at scale, trained on licensed OEM build data across 52+ manufacturer agreements and continuously sharpened by feedback from thousands of users across our global network. No general-purpose AI model comes close on parts accuracy, and that is what makes agentic procurement automation possible at the precision the repair industry demands.
 Your job is to deploy that into markets we haven't cracked yet. Automotive data is scattered around the world in complex, inconsistent formats, and the interesting work is in unifying it into something that drives a customer's business. You'll sit between Sales, Product, and Engineering, resolving the technical blockers that stand between a prospect and a deal, building demos and experimental features that show off what Interpreter can do, and shaping how the product gets built for and applied to each new market.
 Why join now: Partly closed a $50M Series B at a $500M valuation and is scaling fast across the UK, Europe, the U.S., and Australasia, in a $1.9 trillion industry that has barely been touched by modern software. You'd be early, close to the founders and the model, and given real ownership from day one. If you like ambiguity, owning a problem end to end, and being the person who makes a deal technically possible with frontier AI, this role is built for you.
 💻 What will you do
 Unblock new-market deals end to end. Own the technical path from first conversation to a signed pilot across the UK and the Nordics: scope integrations, map end-to-end estimating and parts workflows, and, together with the Commercial team, clear whatever stands between a prospect and a yes.
 Build integrations that make pilots possible. Stand up and debug the connections customers depend on (for example, the CABAS estimating integration for Nordic customer pilots or quick custom interfaces for client-facing demos), working close to the data and the code to get them live in test and beyond.
 Build demos and experimental features. Create market demos and portal prototypes that prove what Partly can do before committing core engineering, iterating fast on what prospects react to.
 Run Technical Readiness Assessments. Produce the TRAs that map a customer's systems and dependencies so both sides know exactly what a pilot requires.
 Turn data into a commercial case. Build value proposition frameworks, calculators, and reporting (for example, insurer reporting dashboards) that show customers the value in their own numbers.
 Be the voice of the UK and Nordics customer to Product. Translate recurring deal blockers into clear, prioritized product asks, and shape how the product gets built and applied for each new market.
 Work cross-functionally to hit deadlines. Coordinate across Sales, Product, and Engineering to solve customer problems and keep deals moving.
 Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here: https://shorturl.at/iAFUX 
 🥷 Your skills
 Comfortable working close to data and code, with the ability to review it independently. You can write SQL, read and debug your way around a codebase, and stand up demos or prototypes yourself rather than waiting on Engineering.
 Strong technical problem solver and systems thinker. You break ambiguous, messy problems into root causes and generalizable solutions, not one-off fixes.

 Self-directed and high ownership. You're comfortable being the only solutions person in a market, owning problems end to end with little hand-holding.

 (Bonus) Experience in the automotive, parts, insurance, or estimating space (CABAS, CCC, Audatex/Solera, or similar), or experience building integrations against messy external data formats.
 Please note: if you don't have all the skills or experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many people count themselves out. We'd love the chance to learn more about you and why you're exceptional.

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.
Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.
UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.
 About the Role
 We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to make our systems work reliably in real-world deployed environments, not just in controlled engineering settings. This role closes the gap between Engineering, Product, Operations, Customer Success, and the customer — owning technical execution in the field, catching issues early, and turning field reality into clear engineering action.
 You'll need to be comfortable operating across domains rather than as a single-discipline specialist: reasoning practically across software, electronics, hardware, comms, and operations, and diagnosing issues with whatever time, tools, and backup are actually available onsite. Expect regular travel and field time, hands-on work outside a narrow job description, and close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer Success.
 What you will do
 Own technical execution in the field — deploying, troubleshooting, and supporting systems in real-world environments outside the lab.
 Diagnose and resolve issues across domains without needing everything translated by specialists, using structured fault-finding under real-world time and resource constraints.
 Prepare for deployments and field activity — checklists, spares, tools, documentation, and readiness checks — to make field operations faster and more repeatable.
 Capture and translate field observations into clear engineering feedback, closing the gap between what's built, what's deployed, and what the customer needs.
 Support demonstrations, trials, and customer-facing technical activity, representing the technical team credibly in front of customers and operators.
 Build working relationships across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer Success, and pitch in on practical, hands-on tasks outside a narrow job description when needed.
 What we're looking for
 Systems-minded engineering judgment — can explain interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs across a complex technical system, and reason practically across software, electronics, hardware, and comms.
 Practical field troubleshooting experience — has diagnosed and solved technical problems in deployed or operational environments (field, workshop, lab, customer site, military, maritime, robotics, aerospace, or automotive settings) with limited time, tools, or backup.
 Deployed operational discipline — has prepared equipment, documentation, checklists, spares, or field processes ahead of operational activity, and is willing and able to travel and work outside a narrow discipline.
 Clear technical communication — can capture faults, risks, and observations clearly, and explain technical issues to both specialists and non-specialists.
 Cross-functional & high-ownership — comfortable supporting hands-on tasks outside a formal role description to help a deployment or event succeed.
 SME-level depth in at least one relevant technical domain — for example software/embedded systems, electronics/comms, or hardware/mechanical systems.
 Customer-facing technical confidence — has represented a technical team in customer-, operator-, or field-facing settings.
 Nice-to-have:
 Background in defence, maritime, robotics, aerospace, automotive, or other high-reliability deployed systems.
 Working technical depth across more than one domain (e.g., software and electronics, or electronics and mechanical systems).

 Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

items.jobDescription:
Am Fraunhofer-Institut für Produktionstechnologie IPT in Aachen gestalten wir mit mehr als 450 Mitarbeitenden die Produktion der Zukunft – digital, nachhaltig und resilient.
In der Abteilung »Glass and Precision Manufacturing« trägst du als Entwicklungsingenieur*in »Werkzeugbau und Glasumformung« maßgeblich dazu bei, ressourcenschonende und innovative Produktionstechnologien für die Herstellung von Optiken und Glaskomponenten zu entwickeln und in den industriellen Einsatz zu bringen. Anwendung finden diese z. B. bei Dünnglaskomponenten in der Automobilindustrie, bei Kameraobjektiven im Bereich Consumer sowie bei Optoelektronikkomponenten für die Datenkommunikation. Nach umfassender Einarbeitung verantwortest Du deine Projekte ganzheitlich, von der Technologieberatung und -planung bis zur technischen Umsetzung in unserem hochmodernen Maschinenpark.
 Hier sorgst Du für Veränderung 
 Entwicklung innovativer Fertigungstechnologien und Setzen neuer Maßstäbe in der Herstellung hochpräziser optischer Glaskomponenten
 Entwicklung und Fertigung anspruchsvoller Präzisionswerkzeuge sowie neuer Werkzeugkonzepte
 Optimierung von Fertigungsprozessen mit Fokus auf Effizienz, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit
 Planung und Durchführung experimenteller Versuche zur Umsetzung neuer Ideen in die Praxis
 Erschließung zukunftsweisender Anwendungsfelder wie Laserfusion und Quantentechnologien
 Akquisition und Leitung spannender Industrie- und Forschungsprojekte mit nationalen und internationalen Partnern
 Präsentation eigener Entwicklungen auf internationalen Konferenzen und im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden
 Hiermit bringst Du Dich ein 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master, Diplom) im Bereich Maschinenbau, Physik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Produktionstechnik oder in einer verwandten Fachrichtung
 Idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung und Kenntnisse in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung
 Begeisterung für die angewandte Forschung, Interesse an innovativen Produktionstechnologien und den Wunsch, in diesem Themenfeld zu promovieren
 Gute analytische Fähigkeiten und Freude an interdisziplinärer Projektarbeit
 Eigeninitiative, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Spaß an Teamwork
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Was wir für Dich bereithalten 
 Ein engagiertes Team mit offener, wertschätzender Arbeitskultur
 Verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in hochinnovativen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit namhaften Industriepartnern unterschiedlichster Branchen
 Ein hochmoderner Maschinenpark, ausgestattet mit Edge-Cloud-Systemen und einer 5G-Infrastruktur
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Unterstützung bei der Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben
 Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
 Möglichkeit zur Promotion an der RWTH Aachen in einem selbst entwickelten Thema
 Ein exzellentes Netzwerk aus Wissenschaft und Industrie mit hervorragenden Karriereperspektiven
 Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Deutschlandticket-Zuschuss, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Benefits 
 Die nachhaltige Erhöhung des Anteils von Frauen in der Wissenschaft ist unser erklärtes Ziel. Mit unserem Karriereprogramm »Fraunhofer TALENTA« bieten wir Berufseinsteigerinnen und Young Professionals zusätzliche Qualifizierungs- und Vernetzungsangebote sowie den nötigen Freiraum zur Gestaltung ihres Karrierewegs.
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf 2 Jahre befristet. Es besteht die Möglichkeit der Verlängerung. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen basieren auf dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD). Zusätzlich kann Fraunhofer leistungs- und erfolgsabhängige variable Vergütungsbestandteile gewähren. 
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt, und mach einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Deiner Online-Bewerbung erhältst Du eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Dir, wie es weitergeht.   
 Auf Deine Fragen zu dieser Position freut sich: 
Cornelia Rojacher M.Sc.
Abteilungsleiterin »Glass and Precision Manufacturing«
Telefon: +49 241 8904-169    
 Fraunhofer-Institut für Produktionstechnologie IPT

System Engineer – Machine Control 
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience
 About us 
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.
 The role 
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.
 You will:
 Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction
 Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable
 Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement
 Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer
 Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring
 Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs
 Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds
 Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab
 Your profile 
 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine
 Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments
 Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition
 Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency
 Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.
 Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software
 This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.
 A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners
 Full professional proficiency in English
 Bonus:
 Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety
 Integration with wafer handling and factory automation
 High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing
 Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data
 Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools
 We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.
 What we offer 
 Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet
 Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product
 Competitive salary for the Dutch market

About us 
 At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 
 Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄  
 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.
 Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.
 We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.
 Introducing the Backend teams at Trainline 👋 
The Backend teams at Trainline build the core of Trainline’s world class product. We create the journey search functionality that millions of our customers use on a daily basis, the eCommerce platform that provides a secure and seamless experience and we connect Trainline to over 270 travel operating companies, across 45 countries in Europe and the rest of the world. Each team has a targeted domain focus, ranging between journey search, fares calculation, bookings, fulfilment, payments, refunds, carriers’ integrations, real-time timetable information, journey disruptions and much more.
 As a mid level .NET Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄 
 Deliver features using the best tools for the job, including AI coding agents
 Ensure quality is at the heart of everything you and your team do
 Continuously improve the code base
 Keep our customer as the number one priority
 Actively identify blockers, boulders, time sinks and waste, and actively attempt to remove them
 Contribute to technical decisions
 Support newer members in the team
 Take ownership of the development lifecycle from code to production, including deployment and monitoring
 Our Tech Stack 🔑
 Languages & Frameworks: C# (.NET 6–10)
 Databases: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL
 Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, Docker, Terraform
 CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions
 Monitoring & Logging: New Relic, ELK Stack
 AI Tooling: Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex), cloud-hosted agents
 We'd love to hear from you if you...🔍 
 Have hands on experience with C# .NET and the latest features
 Love using Agile development practices
 Have hands on experience working on software development of high-volume transactional applications
 Have experience in asynchronous service/processing
 Test your solutions effectively
 Enjoy mentoring less experienced engineers
 Have experience with CI/CD
 Thrive in a diverse, open and collaborative environment
 Have great communication skills
 Are proactive, focused, supportive, honest and a team player
 Have a passion to learn new skills
 Are at home working with AI coding tools, and have opinions on how to get quality, well-tested code out of them
 Want to design and build AI workflows, not just use them
 More information: 
 Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 
 We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 
 We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.
 Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 
 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 
 ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 
 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 
 ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 
 We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.
 Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn , Instagram and Glassdoor ! 
 Compensation: £60K – £70K

Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?   
 Vision:   
 As a global software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust offers an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world’s leading Legal Tech company.   
 Our Impact:   
 From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams across 12 offices in France, the United States, Mexico, Dubai, Morocco, Germany, Spain, Italy and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America and the Middle East.   
 Our Recognition:   
 DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels every year since 2019.   
 The role   
 DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. In this context, business knowledge becomes a strategic asset: it must be explicit, structured and shared so that both our teams and our AI agents can consistently build the right product.   
 Reporting to the Head of Architecture , you will be responsible for the functional coherence of the entire DiliTrust platform, covering all business modules and internal services. You will map our business domains, define functional design standards and ensure they are applied—including by building the AI agents that automate functional validation.   
 This is a role with real authority and a progressive mandate. You will start as a trusted advisor to Product and Engineering teams, then progressively become the approval authority for functional design across the platform. Your ability to simplify complex systems and connect business knowledge with technical execution will be central to your impact.   
 Missions:   
 Map the platform’s business domains: Build and maintain a comprehensive model of capabilities, processes, business rules and data entities across all business modules and internal services, starting with priority areas and expanding progressively.   
 Simplify and rationalize the functional landscape: Apply Domain-Driven Design to define bounded contexts, establish a ubiquitous language and map relationships between contexts. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails.   
 Establish functional design governance: Define principles, standards and reusable patterns; review and approve functional designs and specifications against the global model. Build a clear decision-making framework through documented rules, decision records and review rituals.   
 Make business knowledge usable by people and AI: Maintain a living, machine-readable source of truth comprising domain models, a business glossary and precise specifications. Support spec-driven development and embed this knowledge into the context, skills and tooling used by AI agents across R&D.   
 Build AI-driven functional validation: Design, build and maintain your own AI agents to check specifications, user stories and designs against the domain model and design rules. Assess and improve the functional quality and reliability of AI outputs across coding, testing and review.   
 Align functional and technical architecture: Work with technical architects on APIs, events and data models, ensuring that DDD bounded contexts translate into well-isolated domains within a hexagonal architecture, with business logic independent of infrastructure.   
 Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform.   
 Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working.   
 Requirements   
 Based in France with full working rights.   
 Fluent in French and English.   
 Experience & seniority:   
 10+ years of experience in software, including significant experience in system modeling and functional or solution design on complex B2B SaaS platforms.   
 Proven experience mapping and rationalizing a complex, multi-product platform with a long history.   
 Demonstrated ability to connect business needs, functional models and engineering decisions.   
 Legal Tech experience is not required .   
 Technical expertise :   
 Strong command of strategic and tactical Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, context mapping, aggregates, entities, value objects and domain events.   
 Proficiency in process and system modeling using approaches such as BPMN, UML, C4 and event storming.   
 Ability to write precise specifications, business rules and acceptance criteria, including formats such as Gherkin.   
 Solid understanding of hexagonal architecture, APIs, data models and event-driven architectures, enabling you to engage as a peer with technical architects.   
 Daily use of LLM assistants and AI agents, with the ability to quickly master new tools.   
 Hands-on ability to build and iterate on AI agents through prompting, context engineering, skills, MCP, scripting or low-code approaches as needed.   
 Good understanding of how to evaluate and improve the functional accuracy and reliability of AI outputs.   
 Leadership & collaboration:   
 Strong systems thinking: you understand the whole, recognize interactions and design for coherence over time.   
 A proven ability to simplify rather than add complexity, favoring clear concepts, clean boundaries and minimal models.   
 Structured, concise thinking and the ability to make complex topics understandable to others.   
 The ability to build trust and influence first, then hold a firm line on standards when needed.   
 Excellent communication, teaching and coaching skills across business and technical teams.   
 Education:   
 Your background may be functional—business analysis, product or functional architecture—or technical, such as software engineering or architecture. What matters is your ability to model complex systems and bridge business and technology.   
 Our Tech Stack   
 For information only: the stack evolves continuously, and hands-on expertise in every technology is not expected for this role.

items.jobTitle: Staff Platform Engineer, Fanatics Markets - UK
items.jobDescription:
About Us
 Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.
 About the Team 
 Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow—from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.
 Role Overview 
 As a Staff Software Engineer within our Platform team, you will help define the technical direction of the platform underpinning our exchange and trading systems. You will lead the design and evolution of our infrastructure and platform standards to support a highly available, low-latency exchange, partnering closely with exchange engineers and engineering leads to enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.
 This role requires a balance of deep hands-on software engineering, systems thinking and technical leadership. You will lead complex projects that support the exchange—from load-testing environments and mock integrations to monitoring and automated recovery. You will turn ambiguous requirements into practical designs, own delivery from ideation to production and help operate the platform as the exchange goes live. The balance of coding and infrastructure work varies by project, but you should be comfortable independently developing new software as well as improving existing systems, setting platform standards and mentoring engineers across experience levels.
 On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.
 Responsibilities 
 Lead the design and development of software tools, services and automation that solve complex infrastructure, reliability and developer experience challenges.
 Define and evolve the architecture of highly available cloud-native infrastructure, balancing performance, reliability, security and cost as the platform grows.
 Set technical direction for CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, remaining hands-on in delivering improvements to the software delivery lifecycle.
 Lead the development of load-testing environments and supporting software, including mock services and integrations.
 Establish and evolve standards for AI-augmented development, using effective prompting and validation practices to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.
 Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and help teams evaluate the impact on quality and productivity.
 Guide the design and implementation of platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.
 Shape the system observability roadmap and lead improvements to monitoring, tracing, alerting and automated recovery.
 Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions.
 Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams.
 Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents.
 Skills 
 Significant experience in software, backend or platform engineering, with a track record of leading complex technical projects and delivering production software and scalable, cloud-native environments.
 Deep software development expertise, including the ability to independently design, build, test and deploy services or substantial tools from scratch and guide others through complex implementation decisions.
 Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, including designing and operating production environments, troubleshooting complex failures, and establishing patterns for high availability and efficient scaling.
 Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including making architectural decisions across complex environments.
 High proficiency in Java and Python; Go is a plus. You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic.
 Deep understanding of distributed systems and the ability to make and explain trade-offs between low latency, high availability, scalability and operational complexity.
 Experience shaping CI/CD and observability approaches, with hands-on knowledge of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog.
 Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to ship production code and improve engineering workflows.
 Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for security gaps or architectural errors and establish rigorous testing and validation practices.
 Proven ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear technical direction and deliver improvements across team boundaries, balancing immediate needs with long-term architectural health.
 Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams.
 Experience mentoring senior engineers and building alignment around technical standards and architectural decisions.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in high-growth startup environments.
 Experience with financial systems, exchanges, real-money transactions or regulatory compliance.
 Background in designing and building internal developer platforms, tools, CLI applications or infrastructure automation services.
 Experience developing load-testing environments, mock services or automated recovery systems.
 Experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or evolving platform architecture through significant growth or change.
 Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.
 Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We are open to fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom. Remote employees may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.
 #LI-Remote
 #LI-AL1 
 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. 
 Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it

 Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.
 We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

 What we Offer
