Our Mission ⚖️ 
 At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.
 Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.
 Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.
 Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.
 Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.
 Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.
 And we're just getting started.
 The context 
 Following rapid and profitable growth in France, Doctrine has expanded to Italy and Germany, then acquired Maïté, a Spanish legaltech company, at the start of 2026. 
 We are now looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to keep improving our legal AI for the Spanish market. You will work on models and pipelines that process Spanish legal documents, and your work will directly shape the product roadmap for Spain.
 Please note: the position is based in Paris, in our offices in the 18th arrondissement.
 You can find details about our full stack on GitHub .
 Good to know: prior professional experience in the legal field is not required. However, being eager to commit and build expertise in understanding legal documents is essential.
 Missions 🛠 
 Develop NLP models (machine learning–based or otherwise) to support information search and recommendation within legal documents, with a particular focus on the Spanish language.
 Maintain and monitor these models in production.
 Design conversational agents to help lawyers across different legal domains by ensuring accurate answers and streamlining drafting tasks.
 Collaborate with various profiles — including engineers, product managers, and product designers to identify new opportunities for product development.
 Contribute to spreading and consolidating best practices internally, and take part in shaping our Engineering strategy.
 Ideal Profil 👀 
 Strong knowledge of machine learning (both classical and deep learning) for data extraction and recommendation, ideally with initial experience working with LLMs.
 Experience with natural language search engines and inverted indexes such as Elasticsearch.
 A strong interest in artificial intelligence topics.
 Motivation to identify, analyze, and bring the latest scientific advancements in the field into production.
 Solid Python development skills, with a focus on algorithm design.
 Proficiency in both English and Spanish, as you will be working with legal documents in Spanish.
 Extras of the role 👁 
 Like all engineers at Doctrine, you will join one of our cross-functional chapters — in this case, the Data Science chapter. Within this chapter, you will contribute to internal projects aimed at improving our processes and shaping our long-term vision. The chapter meets every week to:
 Share knowledge : keep track of the state of the art, review scientific papers, continuous improvement, best practices, etc.
 Propose improvements : experiment with new tools, suggest new processes to implement.
 You will also take part in recruitment : all individual contributors meet candidates through technical assessments or interviews.
 What's in it for you ☀️ 
 🏡 A flexible remote work policy - up to 3 days of remote work per week
 🌴 A flexible leave policy
 🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities
 🏄‍♂️ Regular team events 
 📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions
 🍱🚲🏋️‍♀️ Monthly allowance that you can use for sports, wellness activities, subscriptions, and more.
 🍏 Brand new Apple equipment
 Our values 🤝 
 At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.
 Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.
 Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.
 Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.
 Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.
   Our hiring process 🚀 
 A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.
 A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions.
 One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice.
 An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with the VP of your department.
 (The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.) 
 Ladies, go ahead and apply! 
 Research shows that women in particular tend not to apply for a role when they don't meet every single requirement. To put your mind at ease: this job description is a guide, nothing more.
 If Doctrine interests you, we'd love to hear from you!
 Diversity & inclusion 
 All our roles are open to people with disabilities. Feel free to bring it up at any point during the process. We're committed to putting in place whatever adjustments are needed to ensure a working environment that works for everyone.

WisdomTree is a leading provider of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and exchange-traded products (ETPs), offering innovative investment solutions to investors across Europe. Our Investment Research team works across markets, portfolio construction, quantitative research, product development and client-facing market intelligence. 
 We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineer to join our IT team, dedicated to the Investment Management function, supporting our new generation of research technology that combines investment expertise, data, modern software engineering and AI.
 We are looking for someone who is exceptionally productive with modern AI coding tools, but who also has the software engineering fundamentals to understand, maintain and improve the systems those tools help create. A major initial responsibility will be taking ownership of CUBE , WisdomTree's internal platform for Investment Management, that includes Risk Management and Valuation management. CUBE allows portfolio managers and to efficiently manage their portfolios. The platform has grown quickly, which is a good problem to have. Your job will be to take what works, keep the speed and experimentation that made it successful, and progressively make the underlying platform simpler, more robust and easier for other developers to understand and operate.
 You should be equally comfortable using an AI coding agent to build an application in an afternoon and opening the resulting codebase to work out how it actually works.
 Key Accountabilities and Scope 
 Own and evolve the CUBE platform, becoming the primary developer responsible for its architecture, codebase, developer experience, reliability and ongoing operation.
 Work directly with portfolio managers and senior investment professionals to turn loosely defined ideas into useful applications quickly.
 Use modern AI coding tools and agents extensively to prototype, build, debug and refactor software.
 Integrate the CUBE environment in the wider Wisdom tree platform.
 Take AI-generated or rapidly prototyped applications and apply sound engineering judgment so they remain understandable, maintainable and supportable.
 Simplify CUBE development environment and container architecture, particularly the local developer experience, removing unnecessary complexity where possible.
 Improve development and deployment workflows including containers, CI/CD, environment management, logging, monitoring, authentication and configuration.
 Build full-stack research applications using Python and modern web technologies.
 Develop applications that combine LLMs with structured financial data, market data, proprietary research, documents and internal knowledge.
 Build agentic workflows, research assistants, analytical tools, dashboards and workflow automations.
 Integrate applications with WisdomTree's data and technology platforms, including Databricks, databases, APIs, identity systems and cloud infrastructure.
 Debug unfamiliar systems pragmatically. You should be comfortable tracing a problem across application code, containers, APIs, authentication, networking and cloud infrastructure rather than assuming somebody else owns the next layer.
 Establish sensible engineering standards without introducing heavyweight processes that slow down experimentation.
 Document important architectural decisions, dependencies and operational procedures so that knowledge does not live with one developer.
 Skills and Qualifications 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 Strong software engineering fundamentals and substantial hands-on development experience.
 Strong Python skills and experience building real applications rather than only notebooks or analytical scripts.
 Experience with modern web development. React, TypeScript or JavaScript experience is strongly preferred.
 Significant experience using AI coding agents and copilots as part of your normal development workflow.
 Experience building applications using LLMs, agents, tool calling, retrieval or related AI application patterns.
 Strong practical knowledge of APIs, Git, containers and Docker.
 Experience with cloud-hosted applications and CI/CD. Azure experience is useful but not essential.
 A working understanding of authentication, application security, secrets, networking, logging and observability.
 The ability to read an unfamiliar or imperfect codebase, understand why it works and improve it without feeling compelled to rewrite everything.
 Good architectural judgment, particularly the instinct to simplify systems rather than add unnecessary abstraction.
 The ability to work independently with ambiguous requirements and a strong bias toward shipping something useful.
 Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with investment professionals who may know exactly what they want to achieve but not how the software should be constructed.
 An interest in financial markets and investing is important. Deep financial expertise is not required on day one, but curiosity and the ability to learn quickly are.
 Desired Skills and Experience 
 A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Statistics, Finance or another quantitative discipline.
 Databricks, Spark or modern cloud data platforms.
 SQL and large financial or analytical datasets.
 Docker Compose, development containers or improving complex local development environments.
 Azure App Services or similar managed application platforms.
 LLM evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation and agent frameworks.
 Building internal developer platforms or self-service application environments.
 Quantitative finance, investment research, portfolio analytics, ETFs or financial markets.
 Taking an experimental or founder-built codebase and maturing it without destroying the qualities that made it useful.
 About Us: 
 WisdomTree is a global financial innovator, offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products (ETPs), models and solutions, private market investments and digital asset-related products. Our offerings empower investors to shape their financial future and equip financial professionals to grow their businesses. Leveraging the latest financial infrastructure, we create products that emphasize access and transparency and provide an enhanced user experience. Building on our heritage of innovation, we offer next-generation digital products and services related to tokenized real world assets and stablecoins, as well as our institutional platform, WisdomTree Connect™, blockchain-native digital wallet, WisdomTree Prime®*, and have expanded into private markets through the acquisition of Ceres Partners’ U.S. farmland platform.
 Work Smart: 
 Headquartered in New York City, WisdomTree embraces a “Work Smart” philosophy that transcends physical workspace, aiming to optimize productivity, efficiency and effectiveness. Employee time in the office generally is not prescribed, and team leaders are empowered to determine how their teams work best, based on their roles, which may include in-person, in-office engagement.
 Mission, Vision & Values: 
 WisdomTree is committed to delivering a better financial experience through the quality of our products, solutions and engagement, and to be the leader in delivering best structured access to global asset classes, empowering clients through innovative solutions and long-term performance. WisdomTree employees strive for excellence and innovation, work with transparency and accountability and support each other as a global team .  We welcome the applications of qualified individuals who will support this mission and thrive in our collaborative and empowering work environment.

Die Möglichkeit
 Bei Hitachi Energy arbeiten wir gemeinsam an einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die Technik nicht nur verstehen, sondern sie auch vor Ort zum Laufen bringen wollen.
Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Servicegeschäfts im Bereich Hochspannungstechnologie suchen wir technische Talente, die wir gezielt zum Field Service Engineer entwickeln möchten.
In dieser Rolle bist du dort im Einsatz, wo moderne Energieinfrastruktur entsteht und zuverlässig funktionieren muss. Du unterstützt uns in Deutschland und, wenn es zu dir passt, auch international bei der Installation, Inbetriebnahme, Wartung und Modernisierung unserer Hochspannungs- und Hochstromanlagen.
Dabei arbeitest du mit Technologien wie AIS (Freiluftschaltanlagen), GCB (Generatorschaltern), GIS (gasisolierten Schaltanlagen), Transformatoren und Systemen der Hochspannungs-Gleichstromübertragung (HVDC). Sie bilden eine wichtige Grundlage für eine sichere und zuverlässige Energieversorgung und ermöglichen unter anderem die Integration erneuerbarer Energien sowie die effiziente Übertragung großer Energiemengen über weite Entfernungen.
Bei uns musst du nicht bereits alles können. Wir investieren in deine Entwicklung. Durch praxisnahe Einarbeitung, Trainings und Zertifizierungen baust du dein Fachwissen Schritt für Schritt aus und kannst dich langfristig zum Spezialisten für ausgewählte Hochspannungstechnologien entwickeln.
Gemeinsam gestalten wir deinen Karriereweg passend zu deinen Stärken, Interessen und persönlichen Zielen.
 Das kannst du bewirken
 Du installierst, prüfst und nimmst Hochspannungsanlagen und Energieübertragungssysteme in Betrieb, z. B. GIS, AIS, Leistungsschalter, Transformatoren, HVDC-Anlagen und Hybridlösungen.
 Du führst Wartungs- und Serviceeinsätze durch und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Anlagen langfristig sicher und zuverlässig betrieben werden können.
 Du analysierst technische Störungen, führst Diagnosen vor Ort durch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Experten passende Lösungen.
 Du unterstützt Retrofit-, Upgrade- und Modernisierungsprojekte und hilfst damit, bestehende Anlagen fit für die Zukunft zu machen.
 Du sorgst bei deinen Einsätzen konsequent für die Einhaltung unserer HSE- (Health, Safety & Environment) und Qualitätsstandards.
 Du dokumentierst deine Serviceeinsätze nachvollziehbar und erstellst die erforderlichen technischen Berichte.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Teams zusammen und bist gleichzeitig ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden vor Ort.
 Du vermittelst dein Wissen und schulst Kundenpersonal im sicheren Betrieb, in der Anwendung und in der Wartung unserer Anlagen.
 Dein Hintergrund
 Du hast eine technische Ausbildung, zum Beispiel in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder Mechatronik mit elektrotechnischem Schwerpunkt, oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Du begeisterst dich für anspruchsvolle Technik und möchtest dich fachlich im Bereich Hochspannung und Energieübertragung weiterentwickeln.
 Erste Erfahrungen in der Hochspannungstechnik, im Anlagenbau, in der Inbetriebnahme, Montage oder im technischen Service sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.
 Kenntnisse rund um GIS, AIS, Transformatoren, Schaltanlagen, HVDC oder vergleichbare elektrotechnische Systeme sind ein Plus.
 Du bist gerne praktisch unterwegs und bringst Reisebereitschaft für nationale oder, je nach Spezialisierung und persönlicher Präferenz, internationale Serviceeinsätze mit.
 Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen technischen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.
 Im Umgang mit Kunden trittst du professionell, verbindlich und serviceorientiert auf.
 Sicherheit, Qualität und eine gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise sind für dich selbstverständlich.
 Du kannst dich auf Deutsch und Englisch gut verständigen, idealerweise auf mindestens B2-Niveau.
 Mehr über uns
 Hitachi Energy ist ein globales Technologieunternehmen im Bereich der Energieversorgung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Partnern entwickeln wir Technologien und Lösungen für eine zuverlässige, flexible und nachhaltige Energieinfrastruktur.
Als Field Service Engineer bist du dabei nicht nur Zuschauer, sondern arbeitest direkt an der Technik, die für die Energieversorgung von heute und morgen entscheidend ist.
 Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: IG-Metall-Tarifvertrag, 30 Urlaubstage, unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, Fitnesszuschuss, Mehrarbeitszuschläge, Field Service-Zulage und weitere Benefits
 Technik mit Zukunft: Arbeite an Hochspannungsanlagen, Transformatoren und modernen HVDC-Lösungen und damit unmittelbar an Technologien für die Energiewende
 Entwicklung, die zu dir passt: Strukturierte Einarbeitung, technische Trainings, Zertifizierungen und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten vom Einstieg bis zum Spezialisten
 Abwechslung statt Routine: Unterschiedliche Anlagen, Kunden und Projekte sorgen dafür, dass kein Einsatz wie der andere ist
 Deutschland oder international: Je nach Spezialisierung und persönlicher Präferenz arbeitest du in nationalen oder internationalen Projekten
 Starkes Team: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Spezialisten zusammen und kannst auf ein internationales Expertennetzwerk zurückgreifen
 Sicherheit an erster Stelle: Sicherheit, Qualität, Integrität und Nachhaltigkeit bestimmen unsere tägliche Arbeit
 Langfristige Perspektive: Dich erwarten vielfältige Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden und technologisch anspruchsvollen Zukunftsmarkt

Opto-mechanical Engineer 
 This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. 
 About us 
 Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.
 We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.
 Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.
 We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.
 Position Overview 
 London · Full time · On-site
 You'll design the structures that hold our optics still and aligned while stations run unattended in remote, harsh environments.
 What you'll do 
 Design mounts, benches and enclosures for telescope-mounted and bench optics
 Own alignment concepts, and the fixtures and procedures used to set alignment
 Run thermal and structural analysis on optical assemblies, and feed the results into tolerances
 Design for manufacture, assembly and field servicing
 Work with the workshop and suppliers from drawing to finished part
 What you'll bring 
 Experience in opto-mechanical design
 CAD skills (SolidWorks, Onshape or similar), plus GD&T and drawing standards
 Thermal and structural FEA experience
 Hands-on build and alignment experience
 Nice to have 
 Telescope or observatory hardware
 Environmental testing
 Outdoor enclosures and weather sealing
 Space or defence programmes
 What We Offer 
 A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company
 EMI share options (UK employees)
 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays
 Enhanced Parental Leave
 Cycle to work schemes
 Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics
 Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials
 We actively champion underrepresented groups and seek to bridge gaps in our workforce. If you're excited by the role but don't match every point, or you’re seeking a part time role, please apply anyway and add a note into your application. Building the best team is our priority.

Notre mission ⚖️ 
 Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.
 Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.
 Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.
 Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.
 Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.
 Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.
 Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.
 Contexte du stage
  Au sein de l'équipe Fondation (ingénieurs Fullstack et SRE), vous aurez un rôle central pour améliorer l'Expérience Développeur (DX) chez Doctrine : simplifier et sécuriser les processus quotidiens de développement, avec un impact direct sur l'efficacité de toutes les équipes techniques. 
 Conception et spécifications : comprendre et formaliser les besoins avec l'équipe Fondation, puis rédiger le cahier des charges (spécifications techniques et fonctionnelles).
 Planification itérative : une fois le cahier des charges validé, définir un plan de mise en œuvre par lots, pour des livraisons fréquentes et une visibilité constante sur l'avancement.
 Les missions 
 Mission principale : Conception et mise en place d'un outil de validation automatisé dans nos pipelines CircleCI pour vérifier la conformité de notre code d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) avec nos règles internes, au sein d'une infrastructure récente basée sur AWS et Terraform .
 Contrôle augmenté par LLM : Intégration de modèles de langage pour analyser les configurations Terraform , repérer les écarts et générer des explications ou des suggestions de correction directement dans les Pull Requests.
 Industrialisation des règles : Formalisation de nos standards d'infrastructure et automatisation des alertes ou des blocages dans le workflow de build en cas de non-conformité.
 Les à-côtés du poste 👁️ 
 Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras au chapter transverse Software Engineering. Il se réunit 2 fois par mois pour : 
 Partager des connaissances : amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques…
 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
 Support ponctuel : guider les ingénieurs sur leurs besoins liés à l'exploitation
 Chapter meetings (EIR) : accompagnement dédié si tu souhaites présenter ton projet ou un autre sujet technique
 Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 
 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
 Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
 Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
 Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.
 Nos valeurs 🤝 
 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.
 Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
 Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
 Knowledge is power : l 'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
 Release early, release often and listen to your customers : n ous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
 Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

items.jobDescription:
Sie wollen nach dem Studium nicht einer von vielen sein, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen?
 Bei uns arbeiten Sie direkt mit der Geschäftsleitung, bringen eigene Ideen ein und übernehmen eine Schlüsselrolle in der Weiterentwicklung der Kanzlei.
 Wir sind eine Rechtsanwalts- und Steuerkanzlei in Berlin mit rund 40 Mitarbeitenden und einem klaren Fokus auf anspruchsvolle Steuerberatung. Unsere Mandanten erwarten fachliche Exzellenz – und wir wollen technisch auf demselben Niveau spielen. Die Kanzleiprozesse müssen Sie nicht beherrschen. Sie sollten aber Lust haben, sich auf sie einzulassen. Sie bringen den Code, wir den Kontext. Ihr Tech-Know-how plus unsere fachliche Tiefe: Das ist die Kombination, mit der wir neu definieren, was eine Kanzlei leisten kann. Wir arbeiten schon heute intensiv mit KI und sind technisch auf der Höhe der Zeit. Mit Ihnen bauen wir diesen Vorsprung weiter aus.
 Was Sie bewegen
 Sie verantworten die technische Umsetzung unserer Digitalprojekte, eng abgestimmt mit der Geschäftsleitung
 Sie bringen unsere KI-Anwendungen kanzleiweit an den Start und entwickeln sie weiter

 Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder ein vergleichbares Fach

 Kontaktfreude und Gespür für Menschen
 Hands-on-Mentalität, Struktur und Diskretion

 Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Impact, keine Nebenrolle
 Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen
 Raum zum Wachsen und eine langfristige Perspektive
 Vollzeit, in Berlin

Vega is looking for an engineer to build features end to end across our platform from Java/Spring Boot services and APIs to React and TypeScript interfaces – using AI tools as a core part of how they work and helping bring AI-powered capabilities into the product.
 About Vega 
Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
Vega built the industry's first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done – from the start of an investor's journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it's also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
 Who we are 
We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world's leading technology and financial services firms – including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
 How we do it 
Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:
 We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.
 We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.
 We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.
 We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.
 We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.
 We know that this culture won't be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.
 Who succeeds in this role 
We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.
 In this role, you will: 
 Own problems from scoping through shipping and iteration, working directly with business and engineering teams to turn ideas into production features across the full stack
 Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor as a core part of how you design, build, test and review software – and help shape how the team gets the most from them
 Work with our AI engineers to integrate AI features into the platform – wiring agents, LLM-powered workflows and MCP integrations into services and user interfaces, including streaming responses and sensible guardrails
 Build and maintain microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot, contributing to an open architecture that integrates the many players in the private markets ecosystem
 Define, develop and optimise RESTful APIs, owning the contract between front end and back end with scalability and performance in mind
 Work closely with designers to turn mockups into responsive, intuitive interfaces using React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and contribute to the evolution of our design system and theming
 Ensure seamless integration with third-party systems used by PE firms, distributors, private banks and fund administrators
 Identify and fix bottlenecks across the stack – from data flow and service efficiency to front-end rendering and UX
 Champion unit, integration and end-to-end testing, and DevOps best practices
 Share knowledge and support other engineers, contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous learning
   What we look for: 
 Proven professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on work across both front end and back end, ideally on fintech applications
 Fluency with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of your everyday workflow, with sound judgement on reviewing, testing and owning AI-generated code
 Practical exposure to building with LLMs – e.g. calling model APIs, integrating an agent or tool-use flow, or shipping a feature on a platform such as AWS Bedrock – and an appetite to go deeper
 Strong backend experience with Java and Spring Boot, including designing and building microservice architectures with RESTful APIs, and proficiency with SQL and ORMs
 Proficiency in TypeScript, React and Tailwind CSS, with a strong grasp of responsive and mobile-first design
 Experience in modern cloud distributed architecture, particularly AWS, Kubernetes and Kafka
 Solid understanding of unit, integration and end-to-end testing, plus CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks
 Experience working in an agile environment with cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering)
 A proactive problem solver who takes initiative and brings high ambition to a fast-moving team
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on scalable solutions
 Strong communication skills, including explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
   Why join us? 
 You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team
 Competitive salary and equity package
 Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

itemprop="description" class="rtltextaligneligible"> Wir sind Bertrandt. 
 Ein eigenständiger und internationaler Engineering Dienstleister mit langjähriger Expertise. Mit branchenübergreifendem Know-how und einem ganzheitlichen System- und Produktverständnis schaffen wir technologische Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir beschäftigen uns mit den Trendthemen Digitalisierung, E-Mobilität und Autonome Systeme hauptsächlich für die Branchen Automotive, Luftfahrt, Defence und Maschinenbau und ermöglichen hier konsequent die Entstehung passgenauer Lösungen. Tag für Tag – mit rund 12.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an mehr als 50 Standorten weltweit. 
 Was Sie erwartet: 
 Sie behalten auch bei komplexen technischen Projekten den Überblick, denken lösungsorientiert und haben Freude daran, anspruchsvolle Vorhaben erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig! 
 Als Projektleiter Elektrotechnik (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung elektrotechnischer Projekte. Sie koordinieren alle beteiligten Bereiche, behalten Kosten und Termine im Blick und sorgen dafür, dass technische Anforderungen effizient und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
 Die eigenverantwortliche Leitung und Steuerung elektrotechnischer Projekte von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe liegt in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich.
 Sämtliche Projektphasen koordinieren Sie in enger Abstimmung mit Kunden, Lieferanten und internen Fachbereichen.
 Die Überwachung von Kosten, Terminen, Ressourcen und Qualitätsanforderungen gehört zu Ihrem täglichen Aufgabenbereich.
 Die Einhaltung technischer Spezifikationen, geltender Normen und Sicherheitsvorgaben stellen Sie jederzeit sicher.
 Technische Herausforderungen lösen Sie proaktiv und steuern dabei externe Dienstleister zielgerichtet und effizient.
 Was Sie mitbringen: 
 Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker (m/w/d) oder Meister (m/w/d) beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Projektabwicklung im elektrotechnischen Umfeld bringen Sie mit.
 Fundierte Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sowie in der Kosten-, Termin- und Ressourcenplanung zeichnen Sie aus.
 Der sichere Umgang mit technischen Zeichnungen, Schaltplänen und Dokumentationen rundet Ihr fachliches Profil ab.
 Freuen Sie sich auf attraktive Rahmenbedingungen, wie einen  unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, 30 Tage Urlaub , zahlreiche  Sozialleistungen  und  Benefits sowie ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, das Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklung fördert.
 Gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft und bewerben Sie sich noch heute – wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.
 Bertrandt legt großen Wert auf Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit. Unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen basieren auf den Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten der Bewerber*innen. Schwerbehinderte Menschen bzw. gleichgestellte Menschen im Sinne des SGB IX sind herzlich willkommen und werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.
 Sie sind interessiert?

 Bifold 
 About Us 
 Opportunities 
 Research Assistant (ML and Security, PhD Candidate, IV-428/26) 
 Research Assistant (ML and Security, PhD Candidate, IV-428/26)
 The Chair of “Machine Learning and Security” at the BIFOLD institute is seeking a research associate for the research project “AMIRA”. 
 Faculty IV - Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, BIFOLD / Machine Learning and Security
 Research Assistant
 part-time employment may be possible
 About us
 The Chair of “Machine Learning and Security” at the BIFOLD institute is seeking a research associate for the research project “AMIRA”. The project investigates the security and trustworthiness of mechanistic interpretability, a family of methods for explaining neural networks, such as circuit discovery and sparse autoencoders. The goal is to characterize the vulnerabilities of these methods, design novel attacks, and develop appropriate defense mechanisms.
 Your responsibility
 Security analysis of mechanistic interpretability
 Research and development of attacks against these methods
 Research and development of defense mechanisms for these methods
 Scientific publishing and the opportunity to pursue a PhD
 Your profile
 Successfully completed university degree (Master, Diplom or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related technical field
 Strong background in machine learning
 Strong background in computer security
 Experience in adversarial machine learning
 Experience in mechanistic interpretability
 Good knowledge of German and/or English required; willingness to acquire the respective missing language skills
 Ability to conduct independent research is desirable
 What we offer
 Exciting and challenging research
 Collegial and collaborative work environment
 Renowned and dedicated team
 International research network
 How to apply
 Please send your application with the reference number and the usual documents (one file max. 5
 MB) only via email to hashmi@tu-berlin.de .
 All documents must be submitted as a single PDF file. The application must include at least:
 Cover letter
 Complete curriculum vitae (CV)
 Certificates and transcripts (Master’s and Bachelor’s)
 If available, please also include letters of recommendation and publications.
 By submitting your application via email you consent to having your data electronically processed and saved. Please note that we do not provide a guaranty for the protection of your personal data when submitted as unprotected file. Please find our data protection notice acc. DSGVO (General Data Protection Regulation) at the TU staff department homepage: https://www.abt2-t.tu-berlin.de/menue/themen_a_z/datenschutzerklaerung/ .
 To ensure equal opportunities between women and men, applications by women with the required qualifications are explicitly desired. Qualified individuals with disabilities will be favored. The TU Berlin values the diversity of its members and is committed to the goals of equal opportunities. Applications from people of all nationalities and with a migration background are very welcome.
 Salary grade:  TV-L 13, Berliner Hochschulen
 Starting date:  Earliest possible
 Closing date:  November 26, 2026
 Full job posting IV-428/26

A Snapshot of Your Day 
You start your day by exploring data from laboratory cells, test rigs, manufacturing processes, or operating electrolyzer plants and discussing findings with electrochemistry and engineering experts. Together with colleagues from manufacturing, software development, service, and product teams, you translate technical questions into analytical and modeling approaches. You develop data pipelines, build and validate models, and evaluate how AI-supported methods can improve analysis and knowledge transfer. Your work connects insights across the full electrolyzer lifecycle, helping transform complex data into practical engineering decisions and customer value. 
How You’ll Make an Impact 
 * Establishment of a consistent understanding of data across laboratory cells, test rigs, manufacturing processes, and operating electrolyzer plants
 * Development of reproducible analyses and predictive models for performance, degradation, operating behavior, sensor quality, and component health
 * Combination of statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, and physics-based modeling to generate explainable engineering insights
 * Coordination of scalable data pipelines, processing workflows, and model interfaces for integration into analytics and engineering solutions
 * Evaluation and responsible application of AI-supported approaches, including generative and agent-based methods, for analysis, documentation, and knowledge transfer
 * Collaboration with electrochemistry, manufacturing, testing, plant engineering, software, service, and product teams to translate technical and business questions into value-creating data products
What You Bring
 * University degree in engineering, physics, chemical process engineering, electrochemistry, or a comparable quantitative discipline
 * Strong programming expertise in Python and sound software engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and modular software design
 * Experience with data preparation, statistical analysis, visualization, and validation of predictive models using industrial or real-world datasets
 * Understanding of manufacturing processes for electrolysis catalysts and electrolyzer stacks
 * Knowledge of electrolysis, electrochemistry, energy systems, or industrial process data and the ability to connect data-driven findings with physical mechanisms
 * Analytical mindset, practical understanding of modern AI methods, strong communication skills, and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary collaboration
About the Team
Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing 
electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We 
enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and 
integrated execution capabilities.
Who is Siemens Energy? 
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity 
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 
Rewards/Benefits 
 * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
 * We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
 * We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
 * The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
 * In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Job description
 Team & Reporting Line: Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager
 Our Mission   
 At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.
 From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.
 Your Role 
 We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player to join our Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on Flight Software Product Assurance.
 In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.
 The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.
 This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.
 Key responsibilities 
 Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.
 Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.
 Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.
 Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.
 Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.
 Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.
 Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.
 Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.
 Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders.
 Balance the demands of rapid development cycles with the need to maintain strong Product Assurance and software quality standards in a fast-paced space environment.
 Job requirements
 About you   
 Required:  
 Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.
 Proven experience in Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry.
 Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation in safety-critical environments.
 Experience with embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems (experience with FDIR highly desirable).
 Strong proficiency in software configuration management tools and processes.
 Familiarity with ECSS standards, particularly ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) and ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering).
 Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in risk management and anomaly investigation.
 Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.
 Strong team mindset, with a desire to help build and shape a growing organisation.
 Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and delivering in a fast-paced environment.
 Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
 Nice to Have :   
 Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. prompt-based workflows).
 Exposure to high-growth or start-up aerospace environments.
 Broader understanding of end-to-end spacecraft systems engineering lifecycles.
 Why join constellr? 
 High-Impact National Security Mission:  Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.
 Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation:  Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.
 Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure:  Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.
 Inclusive & Scientific Culture:  Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.
 Financial Upside & Well-being:  Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

Who is Sonar? 
 Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,  Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.
Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.   
 Position description 
 At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, advanced agentic workflow and static analysis techniques to complex source code. Your work will directly shape our core products—ensuring both AI-generated and developer-written code meets rigorous enterprise quality and security standards. If you are driven to turn state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.
 What you will do 
 Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible.
 Develop Agentic Workflows : Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities.
 Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase.
 Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools.
 Engineer Data Pipelines : Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
 Translate Prototypes to Products : Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
 Communicate and Evangelize : Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Experience and qualifications 
 Must have:
 Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
 Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages.
 Practical experience with modern agentic frameworks, software automation tools, and LLM architectures.
 Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.
 Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes.
 Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions.
 The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics.
 Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads.
 Plus:
 Background in static analysis: abstract syntax trees (ASTs), code security, bug detection, etc..
 Familiarity with LLM techniques such as model fine-tuning, semantic search engines, etc.
 Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS). 
 Additional comments 
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate. 
 In-office culture 
 We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
 Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.
 We value diversity, equity, and inclusion 
 At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Astrodynamics Engineer 
 This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. 
 About us 
 Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.
 We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.
 Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.
 We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.
 Position Overview 
 London · Full time · On-site
 You’ll be a key contributor to our precision orbit determination platform, Origin. You’ll develop high accuracy, robust and reliable orbit determination and prediction software to provide the gold standard accuracy for orbit products.
 What you'll do 
 Develop, test and improve automated precision orbit determination pipelines and other flight dynamics tooling for Foundational’s Origin platform
 Develop improved force models, measurement corrections and spacecraft modelling
 Build orbit prediction and ephemeris products
 Testing, validation and monitoring of all data products
 Produce high quality software for our platform
 Work with customers on how they use orbit products
 What you'll bring 
 At least 3 years of experience building flight dynamics software
 Knowledge of Python
 Experience with operational orbit determination and good knowledge of techniques
 Experience working with modern software development practices (e.g. CI/CD pipelines, version control, docker)
 Ability to write high quality code, knowledge of standard programming best practice (OOP, design patterns)
 Nice to have 
 Experience with high precision OD
 Knowledge of cloud platforms (ideally AWS)
 Experience with Orekit
 Solid understanding of covariance/uncertainty realism, statistical techniques, etc
 What We Offer 
 A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company
 EMI share options (UK employees)
 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays
 Enhanced Parental Leave
 Cycle to work schemes
 Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics
 Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials
 We actively champion underrepresented groups and seek to bridge gaps in our workforce. If you're excited by the role but don't match every point, or you’re seeking a part time role, please apply anyway and add a note into your application. Building the best team is our priority.

About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 About the role 
 As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.
 Responsibilities 
 Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.
 High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.
 Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.
 Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.
 Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.
 Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.
 Candidate requirements 
 Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.
 Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.
 Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.
 Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).
 Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.
 Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.
 Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.
 Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.
 Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.
 Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. 
 The Opportunity 
 At ANYbotics, we build autonomous, end-to-end robotic solutions that automate routine industrial inspections in complex and hazardous environments. As an Industrialization / Electronics Test Engineer , you will play a central, high-impact role within our Operations team in Zurich, directly enabling the production scaling of our advanced legged robots. 
 By taking ownership of our electronics production test systems, you will bridge the gap between R&D, manufacturing, quality, and external supply partners. You won't just be sitting behind a desk designing isolated components—you will solve challenging real-world problems, build scalable test infrastructure, and directly shape our manufacturing capabilities as ANYbotics continues to expand globally. 
 The Market & Our Technology 
 Industrial facilities present some of the world's most severe operating conditions. Our flagship autonomous platforms, ANYmal and ANYmal X, are designed to navigate multi-story plants, stairs, and hazardous areas—delivering continuous operational insight without human risk. Scaling the manufacturing of these highly sophisticated quadrupedal robots requires robust, state-of-the-art electronics testing setups and a relentless commitment to hardware reliability and product yield. 
 Your Impact 
 Own and continuously improve existing and next-generation electronics production test systems for ANYmal products
 Develop and deploy functional, In-Circuit Testing (ICT), and end-of-line test solutions for complex PCBAs and electronic assemblies
 Drive root-cause analysis on production failures and test data to boost manufacturing quality and yield
 Support the industrialization and rollout of ANYmal X and future robotic platforms
 Introduce best practices for scalable testing, automation, lifecycle management, and hardware maintenance
 Serve as the main technical interface between Operations, R&D, Quality, and EMS manufacturing partners
 Your Profile 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field
 Proven experience in electronics test engineering within a production or hardware manufacturing environment
 Hands-on expertise developing, building, and deploying functional test systems for PCBAs and electronic assemblies
 Strong hardware debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills
 Practical familiarity with standard test equipment such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, and programmable power supplies
 solid understanding of hardware communication protocols including CAN, SPI, I²C, UART, and Ethernet
 Hands-on experience with test automation and scripting languages like Python or LabVIEW
 Proactive, hands-on mindset with a strong drive to collaborate directly with physical hardware and cross-functional teams
 Fluent written and spoken communication skills in English
 Bonus Points 
 Firmware development experience
 Prior industry background in robotics, automotive, aerospace, or industrial electronics
 Experience developing automated test benches using National Instruments hardware/software platforms like TestStand and LabVIEW
 Conversational or fluent German language skills for supplier and EMS communication
 Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, ISO, or IPC standards
 We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact
 Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform.
 Jouw rol
 Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.
 Wat je zal gaan doen: 
 Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.
 Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting.
 Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.
 Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden.
 Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.
 Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.
 Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.  
 Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project.
 Wie ben jij?
 We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands .
 Wat bieden wij jou?
 De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.
 Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.
 Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact.
 Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.
 Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden.
 Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor.
 Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan.
 Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst.
 Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten.
 Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.
 Over Dawn Technology
 We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.
 Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast .
 Solliciteren
 Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 .
 Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. 
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. 
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. 
 Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: 
 Committed to our customers and community. 
 Obsessed with quality. 
 Deliberate in our decisions. 
 Effective as one team. 
 With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. 
 Position description 
 As Sonar’s Marketing AI Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the impact of the marketing function. You spend time with marketing stakeholders to understand their work in depth, identify where automation creates real leverage, and then build and iterate until it works well. You produce clear reporting on efficiency and impact, keeping marketing leadership informed on what the automations are actually delivering. 
 The best person for this role might be a marketing ops veteran who has taught themselves to build with AI, or an automation engineer who has gone deep on how marketing actually works. Either way, what matters is the combination: you understand marketing processes from the inside, and you can build reliable automations that make those processes faster, smarter, and more scalable. 
 What you will do 
 Map and prioritize automation opportunities: Work closely with marketing teams to develop a deep understanding of their day-to-day processes — identifying where AI agents and automated workflows can eliminate manual work, reduce errors, or unlock capabilities that weren’t previously possible. 
 Design and build AI agents: Develop AI agents and automated workflows that streamline marketing processes — from content production and campaign operations to reporting, lead routing, and personalization at scale. 
 Deploy and maintain automations: Own the full lifecycle of deployed agents — from initial release through ongoing monitoring, debugging, and iteration — ensuring reliability and performance as usage grows. 
 Produce efficiency and impact reporting: Track and report on workflow automation metrics — time saved, error rates, throughput, and business impact — delivering regular dashboards and summaries to marketing leadership. 
 Stay current on AI tooling: Continuously evaluate new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms — bringing a clear point of view on what Sonar marketing should adopt, experiment with, or build on next. 
 Partner with Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Collaborate closely with the Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager to understand the existing tool stack, ensure automations integrate reliably with it, and drive adoption of new AI-powered capabilities. 
 Ensure data quality and governance: Design automations that handle marketing data responsibly — with attention to data quality, privacy, and auditability across all deployed workflows. 
 Document and enable: Produce clear documentation for all deployed agents and workflows, and run internal enablement sessions to help the marketing team understand and effectively use what you have built. 
 Experience and qualifications 
 Have 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, automation engineering, or a closely related role — with a track record of building workflows or automations that measurably improved team efficiency. 
 Have deep, hands-on knowledge of marketing processes and tools — including CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation, campaign ops, analytics, and content workflows. A marketing ops practitioner who has grown into building automations is a strong fit. 
 Be experienced with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Make, Zapier, n8n) and comfortable extending them with scripting when needed (Python and/or JavaScript). 
 Have working familiarity with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) or a demonstrated ability and appetite to ramp quickly. 
 Be experienced integrating with third-party APIs and working with marketing data structures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo). 
 Have strong analytical skills and experience building performance dashboards and reporting for deployed automations. 
 Be a clear communicator who can explain what an automation does — and why it matters — to non-technical stakeholders, and translate their requirements into precise technical specifications. 
 Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work. 
 Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 In-office culture 
 We’re intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
 Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that’s not where you are today, we’re happy to support relocation for the right person. 
 We value diversity, equity, and inclusion 
 At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.
